ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: For prayer times, your approximate location is sent to our server to find the nearest Diyanet city, or to Aladhan.com for approximate calculation if data is unavailable. We do not store your location on our server. Qibla direction is calculated on your device.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Motion sensors are used so the Qibla compass can show your phone's heading correctly. The data stays on your device.
